labelers.description: DIDs whose labels this community honours.

linkEmbeds.description: Whether link previews are shown by default.

customEmoji.description: Which custom emoji render in this community. all allows custom emoji from any source, local only the community's own emoji, none disables custom emoji. Disallowed emoji show their fallback text.

hideOwnerBadge.description: Whether the owner badge next to the community owner's name is hidden.

overrideUserNameColors.description: Whether only role colours are shown in chat. Members' own name colours are hidden, and a member without a coloured role shows the default name colour.

requiresApprovalToJoin.description: Whether joining produces an application to approve.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the community.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.

main.description: Updates a community's settings. A field left absent stays unchanged.
